entities.name: Martin Zaťovič
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Martin Zaťovič is a Czech professional ice hockey player currently playing with HC Kometa Brno in the Czech Extraliga (ELH). He previously played the majority of his career with HC Karlovy Vary in the Czech Extraliga during the 2010–11 Czech Extraliga season and enjoyed a two-season tenure in the Kontinental Hockey League with HC Lada Togliatti.
